## What's on this screen

| Element | What it is | Shows / does | Rules | On Linux |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Header actions | toolbar |  | Send test · Rotate secret · Edit · Delete | AdwHeaderBar buttons |
| Filter | chips | status pending\ | succeeded\ | GtkToggleButton pills |
| Rows | table | WebhookDelivery: status, response_status, event_type, event_id, attempt, duration_ms, created_at, next_retry_at, error | failed → Redeliver | GtkColumnView .data-table |

## What happens when you act

| Action | API call | Result |
|---|---|---|
| Send test | `POST /webhooks/{id}/test` | 202 → new pending row appears on refresh (poll 2 s × 5) |
| Rotate secret | `POST /webhooks/{id}/rotate-secret` | confirm (24 h overlap) → KEY-03 |
| Redeliver | `POST /webhooks/{id}/deliveries/{deliveryId}/redeliver` | 202 toast; same event_id |
| Delete | `DELETE /webhooks/{id}` | confirm |

## Good to know

- **Loading, empty and error states:** Loading: skeleton after 300 ms; Error: inline with Retry; codes per COPY-AND-STATES

## For developers

Loads: `GET /webhooks/{id}` · `GET /webhooks/{id}/deliveries?status&since&event_id`

Every call sends `Substratal-Version: 1` to `https://api.substratalapps.com` (no `/v1` in the path). See [API versioning]({{ '/api/versioning/' | relative_url }}) and the [API reference]({{ '/api/reference/' | relative_url }}).
